spans.s: य (1) the consonant य् with अ added to it merely for the sake of facility in pronunciation; यकार is also used in the same sense: e. g. लिटि वयो यः:
cf. T.Pr.I: 17,21; (2) krt affix (यत्) prescribed as कृत्य or potential passive participle; e.g. चेयम्, गेयम्, शाप्यम् , शक्यम् , गद्यम् , अजर्यम् पण्यम् etc.: cf. अचो यत्...अजर्ये संगतम्
-105; (3) krt. affix क्यप् which is also an affix called krtya; e. g- ब्रह्मोद्यम् , भाव्यम, घात्यम् , स्तुत्यम् , कल्प्यम् , खेयम् , भृत्यः:, भिद्यः, पुष्य:, कृत्यम्, also कार्यम् ; cf.
-128: {4) krt affix ण्यत् ( which is also कृत्य ), e. g कार्यम् , हार्यम् , वाक्यम् , लाव्यम्, कुण्डपाय्यम्. etc.: cf
-132: (5) tad. affix य affixed (a) in the sense of collection to पाश, वात etc., as also to खल, गो and रथ, e. g. पाद्या, रथ्या etc. cf.
, 50ः (b) in the चातुरर्थिक senses to बल, कुल, तुल etc. e. g. वल्यः,.कुल्यम् ef. P
, (c) as a Saisika tad. affix to ग्राम्यहः' along with the affix खञ्ज e. g. ग्राम्यः, ग्रामीणः: cf P:
(d) in the sense of 'good therein' ( तत्र साधुः ) and other stated senses affixed to सभा, सोदर पूर्व, and सोम: e. g. सभ्य:, पूर्व्यः; .etc.. cf.
, 109, 133, 137, 138: (e) in the sense of 'deserving it' to दण्ड and other words, e. g. दण्ड्य, अर्ध्र्य, मध्य, मेध्य, etc.: cf
: ( f ) in the sense of quality or action to सखि e. g. सख्यम् ; cf
: (6) tad. affix यत् applied to (a) राजन् श्वशुर, कुल, मनु in the sense of offspring, (b) शूल्, उखा, वायु, ऋतु and others, under certain conditions; cf.
, 31, 32, 101, (c) to अर्ध, परार्ध, words in the class headed by दि्श, छन्दस and others in specific senses; cf P.
-46, 54 etc. and (d) in specific senses to specific words mentioned here and there in a number of sUtras from
; (e) to शाखा, मुख, जघन and others in the sense of इव (similar to) e.g. शाख्यः, मुख्य:, etc.: cf.
; (7) case-ending य substituted for ङे of the dative sing; e. g. रामाय cf.
: (8) verb-affix यक् applied to the nouns कण्डू and others to make them ( denominative ) roots; e. g. कण्डूय,सन्तूय etc. cf. कण्ड्वादिभ्यो यक्

(9) | Vikarana य ( यक् ) applied to any root before the Saarvadhaatuka personal endings to form the base for the passive voice as also the base for the 'Karmakartari' voice e g क्रियते, भूयते, cf. सार्वधातुके यक्

(10) Unaadi affix य ( यक् ) applied to the root हृन् to form the Vedic word अघ्न्य: cf अघ्न्यादयश्च: ( 11 ) augment य ( यक् ) added to the affix क्त्वा in Vedic Literature: e. g. दत्त्वायः cf. क्त्वो यक्
; (12) verb affix यङ् added to a root to form its Intensive base ( which sometimes is dropped ) and the root is doubled. e. g. चेक्रीयते,चर्करीति;. cf.
,24; (13) short term ( प्रत्याहृार ) supposed to be beginn- ing with य in the affix यइ in the sUtra धातेरेकाचो ... यङ्
, and ending with ङ् in the sUtra लिड्याशिष्यङ्क
, with a view to include the various verb affixes and conjugational signs.
या substitute for a case affix in Vedic Literature; e.g. उरुया, धृष्णुया for उरुणा, धृष्णुना, cf. सुपां सुलुक्o
